evidence: Filtered news leading into May 8, 2022 reveals strong bearish momentum and persistent downward selling pressure on Bitcoin. Recent reporting highlights that Bitcoin dropped below and is clinging weakly to the $36,000 level following heavy liquidations exceeding $407 million. On-chain analysis indicates aggressive selling by short-term holders and multiple prominent analysts are warning of further immediate downside targets around $28,000 to $30,000. While some isolated buying and cautious dip-buying commentary were noted, the balance of immediate, short-horizon sentiment and market structure heavily tilts negative for the 24-hour horizon.
limitations: All accepted items are unverified free crypto news sources without authenticated mainstream financial wire corroboration.
